items.title: Selected Work
items.excerpt: Selected formalizations, optimization notes, research directions, and a supporting computational prototype.
items.content: Selected Work Research Statement Technical Notes Selected Work Feier Lyu （Fay Lyu） 这一页集中展示可核查的学术成果、形式化项目与研究笔记；创意计算原型单独列为 side project。完整的问题线与研究动机放在 Research Statement。 Selected Work Feier Lyu (Fay Lyu) This page presents verifiable academic outputs, formalization projects, and research notes. A creative-computation prototype is listed separately as a side project. The broader problem framing belongs in the Research Statement. ACADEMIC WORK 学术工作 01 FORMAL VERIFICATION Greedy Algorithms for Cardinality-Constrained Submodular Maximization 状态： 发表于 AFP，2026。AFP 条目覆盖 classical greedy 与 verified stateful lazy-greedy；当前仓库另含发表后的 stochastic-greedy 扩展，包括 sampling、approximation packaging 与 oracle-cost accounting。 问题： 形式化基数约束单调子模最大化中 classical greedy 的经典 1−1/e 近似保证。 贡献： 在 Wenda Li 老师指导下独立完成 Isabelle/HOL development，覆盖 classical greedy 与 verified stateful lazy-greedy variant。 证据： AFP Proof document GitHub DOI 02 FORMAL VERIFICATION First-Order Methods for Smooth Convex Optimization in Isabelle/HOL 状态： 已提交至 Archive of Formal Proofs，目前等待审核。 问题： 将 projected gradient descent 及其一阶收敛理论组织成可复用的 Isabelle/HOL 基础设施。 贡献： 独立设计并完成全部形式化，覆盖 projection geometry、projected-gradient mapping、凸收敛与强凸线性收敛率；该项目没有导师参与。 证据： Project page GitHub 03 OPTIMIZATION / MINIMAX LEARNING TTGDA and Second-Order Tracking 状态： Working note / exploratory theoretical work. 问题： Two-timescale value-function tracking 是否能通过 Schur-complement Hessian 支持二阶 saddle escaping？ 贡献： 整理 value-function viewpoint、二阶 tracking gap 与可继续检验的 theorem-level 路线。 证据： Note 04 DUALITY / INVARIANCE Duality and Structural Scoring under Invariance 状态： Ongoing theoretical work. 问题： 当 translation 或 gauge invariance 使普通对偶退化时，能否恢复与 localization instance difficulty 相关的结构证书？ 贡献： 推导并整理 dual collapse、Range(B)、cycle consistency、structural scores 与 saddle certificates 之间的联系。 证据： Research note Derivation history CREATIVE COMPUTATION Experimental Prototype SIDE CREATIVE COMPUTATION / EXPERIMENTAL PROTOTYPE Metalcore Piano Lab 状态： Side project · experimental prototype · work in progress；不作为 research output。 问题： 如何把连续的 audio / rhythm streams 转换为保留节拍、段落与可玩性约束的离散谱面？ 贡献： 设计并实现 browser-native 分析与谱面生成原型，包括 onset、beat-grid、section alignment 与 playability constraints。 证据： GitHub Project note ACADEMIC WORK Academic Work 01 FORMAL VERIFICATION Greedy Algorithms for Cardinality-Constrained Submodular Maximization Status: Published in AFP, 2026. The AFP entry covers classical greedy and a verified stateful lazy-greedy variant; the current repository additionally contains a post-publication stochastic-greedy extension with sampling, approximation packaging, and oracle-cost accounting. Problem: Formalize the classical 1−1/e approximation guarantee for cardinality-constrained monotone submodular maximization. Contribution: I independently completed the Isabelle/HOL development under the supervision of Wenda Li, covering classical greedy and a verified stateful lazy-greedy variant. Evidence: AFP Proof document GitHub DOI 02 FORMAL VERIFICATION First-Order Methods for Smooth Convex Optimization in Isabelle/HOL Status: Submitted to the Archive of Formal Proofs; awaiting review. Problem: Formalize projected gradient descent and its first-order convergence theory as reusable Isabelle/HOL infrastructure. Contribution: I independently designed and completed the development, covering projection geometry, projected-gradient mapping, convex convergence, and a strongly convex linear rate. This project had no supervisor. Evidence: Project page GitHub 03 OPTIMIZATION / MINIMAX LEARNING TTGDA and Second-Order Tracking Status: Working note / exploratory theoretical work. Problem: Can two-timescale value-function tracking support second-order saddle escaping through the Schur-complement Hessian? Contribution: Developed the value-function viewpoint, isolated the second-order tracking gap, and organized a theorem-level route for further verification. Evidence: Note 04 DUALITY / INVARIANCE Duality and Structural Scoring under Invariance Status: Ongoing theoretical work. Problem: When translation or gauge invariance collapses a standard dual, can one recover structural certificates tied to localization instance difficulty? Contribution: Developed and organized the connection among dual collapse, Range(B), cycle consistency, structural scores, and saddle certificates. Evidence: Research note Derivation history CREATIVE COMPUTATION Experimental Prototype SIDE CREATIVE COMPUTATION / EXPERIMENTAL PROTOTYPE Metalcore Piano Lab Status: Side project · experimental prototype · work in progress; not presented as a research output. Problem: How can continuous audio / rhythm streams become discrete charts while preserving beat, section, and playability constraints? Contribution: Designed and implemented the browser-native analysis and chart-generation prototype, including onset detection, beat grids, section alignment, and playability constraints. Evidence: GitHub Project note
